notes.title: Patch 0.11.6
notes.content: [p]A bit of a small patch, since we were slowed down by marketing, funding and administrative burdens, but we’re keeping up some interesting changes…[/p][h3]Virtual garage slots[/h3][p]The game now features so-called virtual garage slots that allow players to build with every part and module in the game, but only use those builds in practice. A given virtual build can be upgraded to a real build, if the needed tech has been unlocked and enough parts/cash are available.[/p][p]Virtual builds can also be imported from a blueprint code, although the usual import fee still applies.[/p][p]Virtual garage slots can be earned trough play, and will also be included in the playtester package.[/p][h3]Social functions[/h3][p]We are building out social functions to help build out the community around Diode Arena and to help you play with your friends, currently we just have a basic framework although concrete functions will expand quickly[/p][list][*][p]Friends list[/p][list][*][p]Steam friends who have also logged into Diode Arena are automatically in you friends list[/p][/*][*][p]Friends can be added in game[/p][/*][*][p]Friends list shows last login date[/p][/*][*][p]Currently this list serves no other purposes, functions such as forming parties and inviting friends to ongoing games are coming soon[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Additional interaction options[/p][list][*][p]Calling vote-kick[/p][/*][*][p]Muting[/p][/*][*][p]Rewarding players for friendliness, style or skill[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Minor features & changes[/h3][list][*][p]Replays have been repaired back to basic functionality, although there are still a lot of bugs to address.[/p][/*][*][p]The mouse will now by default stay constrained in the play window, helping players to play in windowed mode or with multiple screens[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional control options for builder and UI quality of life[/p][list][*][p]Can zoom in/out with the scroll wheel while holding ctrl[/p][/*][*][p]Can rotate the camera by right-clicking on empty space[/p][/*][*][p]Changed edge-scroll so that mouse remains locked into the screen and pushing further out pushes the camera in that direction[/p][/*][*][p]Tab key can be used to cycle trough input fields on screens that have multiple inputs (login and account creation)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removed voucher exchange options since these were are unnecessary and too confusing[/p][/*][*][p]Added achievements to the inventory display (you can open this by clicking on your available currency)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]Modifications for Steam login which should make it more reliable[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.11.5
notes.content: [p]Hi all! We'll be starting to keep patch notes on Steam since we want the development activity to be clearly visible to all. Patch 0.11.5 is just a small update with some notable updates to the damage, heal and shield mechanics that we would like to get out to get some balancing data. Apart from that just another batch of QOL updates and bugfixes, enjoy![/p][h3]Damage system update[/h3][p]Damage types in Diode Arena have been split in different types:[/p][list][*][p]Penetration: damage propagates in a straight line[/p][/*][*][p]Creep: damage passes via connections to neighbouring parts[/p][/*][*][p]Explosion: damage fans out in semi-random directions around an impact point[/p][/*][/list][p]Plasma guns now use creep damage in stead of penetration.[/p][p]Also made some overhauls for healing and bubble shields:[/p][list][*][p]Added an overheal mechanic where all bots can receive temporary bubble shields. These shields decay naturally over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Heal guns can apply overheal, a new bonus spec will increase the maximum allowed overheal[/p][/*][*][p]Bubble shields can now regen when active (when the relevant module is equipped) but only after not taking damage for 5 seconds. They can still immediately recharge when de-activated[/p][/*][*][p]Team base heal will now apply temporary bubble shields[/p][/*][*][p]Removed spawn invulnerability mechanic (which was also broken), in stead a bot will receive 100 overheal on spawn, decaying at 15/sec. These values will be balanced in the future![/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor features & changes[/h3][list][*][p]Introduced simplified builder controls, where the mouse remains free and you use the keyboard to orbit the camera around a center point. This is enabled by default but can be disabled in the options to restore the old builder controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a feature where you can hold down a key to lock camera aim in place and move the aiming reticle over the screen with the mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Updated models for flight and yaw gyro[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to add username/password to an existing Steam based login[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to trigger a password recovery e-mail from the login screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added a slider to display tech tree zoom level[/p][/*][*][p]Post-match reward screen will now be displayed for 20 seconds iso 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to send pings on the mini-map[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed problem with exploding number of shader variants bogging down build times; full build time has been reduced from 3 hours to 8 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]Modified team-color reveal to work better with the new free painting approach, i.e. a player with a red paint job in team blue won’t be revealed behind walls to enemies in the red team.[/p][/*][*][p]Avoid displaying tier twice in the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed problem with calculation of the reward bonus factor, leading to an almost universal 200% bonus[/p][/*][*][p]Added a small delay to triggering auto ready since it was so fast it could break level transitions[/p][/*][*][p]Visibility checks for revealing mini-map arrows and player info tags will now be blocked by smokescreens[/p][/*][*][p]Name tag sort-order is now based on distance and can change in stead of being determined by join order[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where activated bubble shields would remain visible after self-destructing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where your own heal beams became invisible while in first person view[/p][/*][/list]
